probes.name: book92
probes.about: Round 10002 case 92's book and variants: a row's top edge clearing a cell read from the file
probes.prefix:
Public Function Probe() As String
Dim wb, ws, s, c: Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set wb = Workbooks.Open("{book}"): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
probes.suffix:
s = ws.UsedRange.Address & ";"
On Error Resume Next
ws.Rows(2).Borders(8).Color = 65280
s = s & Err.Number & ";" & ws.UsedRange.Address & ";"
Set c = ws.Range("A1"): s = s & "A1=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("B1"): s = s & "B1=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("C1"): s = s & "C1=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("A2"): s = s & "A2=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("B2"): s = s & "B2=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("C2"): s = s & "C2=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
Set c = ws.Range("B3"): s = s & "B3=" & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "/" & c.Borders(9).Color & " "
wb.Close False
Probe = s
End Function

probes.name: round16004
probes.prefix:
Public Function Probe() As String
Dim wb, ws, s, c, b As
probes.suffix:
Err.Number & ";": Err.Clear
s = s & TypeName(b.LineStyle) & ":" & b.LineStyle & "," & TypeName(b.Weight) & ":" & b.Weight & "," & TypeName(b.Color) & ":" & b.Color & "," & b.ColorIndex & "," & b.ThemeColor & ";": Err.Clear
s = s & ws.UsedRange.Address & ";"
Set c = ws.Range("A1"): s = s & c.Borders(7).LineStyle & "," & c.Borders(7).Color & "," & c.Borders(8).LineStyle & "," & c.Borders(8).Color & "," & c.Borders(9).LineStyle & "," & c.Borders(9).Color & "," & c.Borders(10).LineStyle & "," & c.Borders(10).Color & "," & c.Borders(8).Weight & "," & c.Borders(9).Weight & ";"
